name: Tinkatuff
description: Tinkatuff, the Hammer Pokémon, and the evolved form of Tinkatink. Able to evolve into Tinkaton. A Fairy and Steel type.
pokedex_entries: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.
These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other's hammers by smashing them together.
